backdrop.bias: soft: lost $81K overnight, holding the $80.4K-80.5K Oct 23 low; Fed and BOJ next week
backdrop.commentary: Morning (6:15 AM CT, Oct 24): BTC ~$80.6K (-1.1% 24h; 24h $80.41K-$81.94K) drifted lower on a thin Saturday and is sitting on Friday's ~$80.4K low, with the Oct 15-18 lows (~$80.1K, 30-day low) and ~$79.7K under it. Flows stayed soft: US spot BTC ETFs lost a net $137.9M on Oct 23 (IBIT -$110.3M), a second outflow day after Thursday's -$635.6M, but the week still finished +$301.2M and October is about -$313.5M (Farside, CryptoWatchDesk). Macro is the weight: Brent settled at $116.72, its highest since April 29, after attacks on Saudi energy sites, the Dow fell 1.2% and the 10-year yield is back near 4.99% (Reuters, CoinDesk). Signals: 1h/4h Sell under the 4h EMAs (~$81.6K-82.0K), 4h StochRSI pinned at 0; 1d Sell, under the EMA20 (~$82.2K) and right on the EMA50 (~$80.8K), well above the EMA200 (~$75.9K). Fear & Greed 46 (neutral), OKX funding ~0.01%, open interest ~30.6K BTC, total market cap ~$2.69T (-4.8% 24h), BTC dominance ~60%. Yen: USD/JPY ~156.8 (Yahoo; Friday range 156.07-157.16). The yen had its best week since early September on safe-haven buying (CNBC) and Japan's core CPI hit 2.1%, but 155 has not broken, the BOJ is expected to hold on Oct 30 (October hike odds under 20%) and a December hike is about 59% priced. Carry-unwind risk is elevated, not acute; a fast drop under 155 or a BOJ surprise would be the trigger, so longs stay low-leverage. Policy backdrop: the OCC's final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule takes effect Jan 18, 2027, the CFTC's retail-crypto notice is open for comment to Dec 14, and with the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate the SEC is working through exemptions (tokenized-stock venue relief, a pending crypto-offering proposal). T009 filled at $80.4K overnight; the stop sits under the 30-day low at $78.9K, and the idea closes at market before the Oct 28 Fed decision if still open.

ripple.bias: bearish: under 1.30, sitting on the 1.27-1.28 shelf; 1.259 Oct low next
ripple.commentary: Morning (6:15 AM CT, Oct 24): XRP ~$1.28 (-2.6% 24h; 24h $1.27-$1.32) stayed under the $1.30 floor it lost Friday evening, and the Oct low ($1.259) is the next test, then ~$1.246. Recovery needs a close back above $1.30-1.31 first, then the 4h EMAs (~$1.31-1.32) and the daily EMA cluster at ~$1.351-1.372 (20/50/200-day). Signals: 1h Sell, 4h Sell, 1d Strong Sell below all daily EMAs; RSI ~35-38 on every timeframe, weak but not deeply oversold. News flow is constructive but slow-acting: Franklin Templeton added about $150M of its tokenized money-market fund (sgBENJI) to the XRP Ledger, nearly quadrupling it to ~$200M, though all of it sits in one wallet linked to the issuer (CoinDesk). Ripple and Arf's RLUSD settlement financing and Singapore's BLOOM initiative (with Malaysia and Thailand) also stand; the XRPL fixCleanup security fix is now due Nov 4. Spot BTC ETF outflows and Brent above $116 keep the backdrop risk-off. T011 still waits for a relief rally into $1.355-1.37 at the daily EMAs; there is no breakdown entry because price is already past its first target.

stellar.bias: bearish: broke the 0.172 low to ~0.169; 1h/4h oversold; Meridian Oct 28-29
stellar.commentary: Morning (6:15 AM CT, Oct 24): XLM ~$0.1698 (-3.5% 24h; 24h $0.1687-$0.1774) lost the $0.172 30-day low overnight and set a new one near $0.1687 (-14% over 30 days). Signals: 1h and 4h Sell but oversold (RSI ~29.5, price at the lower Bollinger bands), 1d Strong Sell under the daily EMAs (~$0.186-0.191, EMA200 ~$0.190). The broken $0.172 is first resistance, then the 4h EMA20 (~$0.176) and EMA50 (~$0.180). Below, the daily lower band is ~$0.163. The adoption run is the strongest on the watchlist but hasn't moved the token: the first regulated Treasury-backed repo on Stellar (Ascend Markets and M1X Global, 72 hourly rollovers, under one cent in fees), U.S. Bank's live USBDC stablecoin pilot, and Zebec payroll on Stellar past $5M. Meridian runs Oct 28-29 (same days as the Fed), and the Bell (Protocol 30) testnet vote is Nov 3. No setup: a short at a fresh low with the 1h/4h oversold has its stop far above for little room, and a long needs a reclaim of ~$0.172-0.176.
